A young '''member''' of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was active around<ref name="Codex" /> [[3703 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|An Iron Fist|Alderaan}} indicates that [[House of Thul|House Thul]] was exiled sixty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', placing their exile around [[3703 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Unidentified crown prince|crown prince]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was arranged to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a [[Unidentified Thul child|daughter]] of the noble [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] discovered that the girl was in fact a member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]], having been switched at [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] with an [[Unidentified Organa infant|Organa infant]], and stopped the wedding by exposing the deception. The Jedi's revelation ultimately saw House Thul [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] for their treachery.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi involved in the Thul scandal was mentioned in the House Thul Codex entry in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
